create_training_desc_from_args: create a TrainingDesc object from argparse namespace arguments for model, dataset, and training hyperparameters
add_training_args_to_parser: add dataset, model, and training hyperparameter arguments to an argparse ArgumentParser with optional defaults
get_training_end_step: get the end step for a training run based on dataset iterations per epoch and training steps
get_training_run_path: get the file system path for a training run given a replicate number and experiment name
display_training_desc: display a formatted summary of dataset, model, and training hyperparameters for a TrainingDesc instance
